primary_recommendation.meaning: Maintain the named ETF core only as a controlled paper-observation candidate, do not activate an external transaction, and retain a zero-weight futures switch.

current_evidence_reconciliation.interpretation: The defined R01 paper benchmark, C16, and C17 do not establish a stable outcome, an investor result, personal operability, or a current action. This bounded finding does not preclude a future separately evidenced domestic hypothesis.

candidate_universe.c30_relationship: D5PT-C30-PROTOCOL-v1 is a separate non-admitted semiannual fixed-weight research protocol. It cannot replace the R01 action card, cadence, target map, or product universe.
candidate_universe.c31_alignment: C31 keeps the same five exact codes as the C30 core and keeps 510500, 511180, and 511380 outside it. Its dated product refresh does not establish action-date terms, access, quote, fill, or settlement.

calendar_and_actions.observation_cadence: after the final common trading-session close of each calendar month
calendar_and_actions.signal: strictly positive trailing change over 252 common observations; equity is the fixed-base equal-weight level of 510300 and 510880
calendar_and_actions.target_timing: signal is frozen after D close and may be considered no earlier than next common trading session E

dated_category_reference.boundary: A category reference only; every paper action must retain product-, venue-, account-, and date-specific evidence.

rounding.method: floor each target to the verified lot

limit_price_protection.paper_buy_recording_condition: displayed ask is at or below buy_cap
limit_price_protection.paper_sell_recording_condition: displayed bid is at or above sell_floor
limit_price_protection.missing_iopv_or_two_sided_quote: no_action for the entire scheduled rebalance
limit_price_protection.interpretation: A paper protection rule, not evidence of executable liquidity or a fill.

paper_order_controls.atomic_equity_pair: Any planned equity action fails for the entire scheduled rebalance if either 510300 or 510880 fails a required control.

partial_fill.current_method: No partial paper fill may be invented. An incomplete planned rebalance is no_action until a future independent protocol supplies a frozen partial-fill method.

equity_etf.dated_category_reference: P01 records the SSE ETF FAQ captured 2026-08-15 as classifying equity ETFs as T+1.
equity_etf.paper_rule: newly acquired paper units have an earliest-sellable field no earlier than the next trading session; same-session reversal is prohibited

bond_gold_money_etfs.dated_category_reference: P01 records the same FAQ as saying these ETF categories may support T+0.
bond_gold_money_etfs.paper_rule: same_day_roundtrip_allowed defaults to false unless specific product, venue, account, settlement, and availability evidence is retained on E

all_instruments.missing_or_contradictory_evidence: no_action for the entire scheduled rebalance

bid, ask, IOPV when applicable, depth, price-limit/halt state, and price-protection checks

instrument_admission_and_exit.suspension_response: suspended or no_action; no substitute, artificial exit, historic quote, NAV, close, or parameter revision
instrument_admission_and_exit.resumption: dated evidence refresh, cause-and-remedy record, reconciled ledger, and independent release
instrument_admission_and_exit.version_change: requires a new version and restarts the forward-paper observation clock

diversification_and_caps.equity_pair_rule: 510300 and 510880 are one equity sleeve and each remains 50 percent of that sleeve
diversification_and_caps.single_instrument_control: A 100 percent state in the frozen R01 map is a concentration exposure, not diversification. A future paper action requires a current single-instrument concentration review; failure is no_action with no substitute.
diversification_and_caps.ad_hoc_lower_cap: prohibited because it would change the frozen R01 rule; any such change requires a new version, independent reconstruction, and new forward-paper observation
diversification_and_caps.combine_with_other_strategy: prohibited while no strategy is admitted

drawdown_and_operational_stops.measurement: DD_t = U_t / max(U_0 ... U_t) - 1 from a reconciled paper unit ledger after recorded fees, taxes, events, and valid paper results
drawdown_and_operational_stops.amber_response: independent input, document, cost, quote, settlement, event, and reconciliation review before the next scheduled cycle; no signal, weight, or stop-sale change
drawdown_and_operational_stops.red_response: red_operational_pause blocks new candidate paper actions until independent control release; preserve ledger and evidence; do not manufacture a liquidation or modify the target map
drawdown_and_operational_stops.hard_operational_exception_response: suspended or no_action for data, documentation, account, settlement, quote, IOPV, price-limit, halt, reconciliation, or version-control failure

basis.boundary: Both are gross settlement-mark diagnostics that omit fills, costs, margin, account access, price-limit locks, delivery, and other execution facts. Independent audit validates bounded arithmetic only.
